title: Abo-Falle und ein Buch, das nichts Neues bringt - Finger weg!
body:
Das einzige, was an dem Buch „The Lasting Change“ personalisiert ist, ist der Name, der auf dem Titelblatt steht. Ansonsten ist es eine Sammlung der üblichen Selbstoptimierungs
-Weisheiten, die sich ohnehin in diversen Ratgebern finden lassen, von denen man sich fürs gleiche Geld ein halbes Dutzend anschaffen kann. Die Übersetzung aus dem Englischen hat eine KI besorgt, anders lassen sich diverse sprachliche Schnitzer nicht erklären.
Das Abrechungs- und Abosystem ist intransparent und betrügerisch. Dass ich ein Abo abgeschlossen hatte, merkte ich erst, als das Geld abgebucht wurde, es war weder im Mailverkehr noch in der App dokumentiert. 
Ein Gutes hat das Ganze: ich werde nie wieder auf entsprechende Angebote auf Instagram & co. hereinfallen.
author: Stoffelhirn

title: Abofalle
body: Habe leider ein Produkt dieser Firma gekauft und habe diese App als Abo-falle mit bekommen.
author: MarkusMuster

title: Unexpected charges
body: I bought the book I really liked and unknowingly activated a €30 app subscription I never used. Unfortunately, I’ve now been charged €120 without realizing it. I wasn’t aware of this subscription and hope for a refund. I also hope the subscription info will be made clearer in the future for other users. Happy to give feedback if support resolves this – unlike many reviews I’ve seen.
author: JaninaVOE

title: App OK. Customization = Scam. Subscription illegal
body:
The advertised “customization” based on the endless questionaries in the onboarding flow is just a Scam. All they customize is the name on the cover of the (e)book. Nothing of the answers has any impact on the app, book content or anything else. Pure psycho trick to make you “feel invested”. 
Basically their onboarding is a “how to” on manipulation (fake questions, artificial delays, pseudo customization, pseudo last time offers, …). 
Also trying to get out of the subscription - which you can only get via web as it seems - is neither possible in the app nor their website. Highly illegal for an EU based company. 

Also the app is buggy in various forms. E.g.: - Forgets your login if you happen to open the app with bad network condition. 
- Requires a restart every day otherwise the current day won’t show up in the timeline/home screen to enter data. 
- Various broken/jumpy UI animations.
author: FlorianG91

title: Seems a good app to accurately track habits,…
body: … however I am a little disappointed by the nutrition section within the app. Unfortunately it has a very limited amount of meals to choose from and right now I am not quite sure how it is supposed to support healthy eating habits, since there is no “rating” of food quality. Also, I couldn’t find the option to sort of time-stamp the food I ate nor what amount it was. So at the end of the day you just log in you, for example, ate “burger”, “pancakes” and drank coffee, but there is no way to be more precise about it. This “time stamp” is being added automatically to the other tracking sections within the app, like the mood tracker, which I find very helpful as it inspires to reflect more on what exactly drives the mood to change during the day. It’s also nice to have different challenges to choose from. I am still exploring all the options the app has to offer and have not received the Lasting Changes personalised workbook yet, but for now it seems to be a great idea to implement healthy habits into daily life.
author: Nicuuush
